kit_running.speaker: kit
kit_running.text: Something's happened on King Street. Soldiers fired into the crowd. People are dead.

senoj_weigh.speaker: senoj
senoj_weigh.text: Every printer in Boston is about to tell this story. Before you believe any of them, weigh the evidence.

john_adams.speaker: sivart
john_adams.text: Wait, John Adams? The Patriot? He defended the soldiers?

john_adams.speaker: senoj
john_adams.text: He believed everyone deserves a fair trial. He said facts are stubborn things, and they can't be changed by our wishes. Keep that one.
